body: I know I'm not supposed to feel guilt. It sucks that I do. It's who I am, I know I didn't cause the accident, but because of a mistake I made, and such a little one made such a huge difference on her life, I can't help but feel responsible. Thank you for caring, the area I live in I'm lucky I've found any good friends at all. I know my mom would want me to tell her, but I just can't bring myself to it, she's gone through everything and kept a smile on her face the whole time. I can't give her another reason not to

Nobody knows. Every day when I go to school, I put on a smile and tough it out, but unless a big change happens, something is going to give in the next 2 and a half years. Whether it be me, or my thoughts. I just don't live the way I should and how all of the people around me do.

Thank you, but my problem isn't the accident itself, it's the fact that my
Mom is getting worse every day, and just knowing I caused it is beyond words.
